versions.alignmentNote: React Native, React, react-native-screens, safe-area-context and AsyncStorage are the versions Expo SDK 58 (expo 58.0.17 bundledNativeModules.json) selects, so `repack` and `expo` share RN 0.88.0, Hermes V1 and the New Architecture (design §14.4)

android.release: R8 minify + shrinkResources (enableProguardInReleaseBuilds = true), Hermes V1 bytecode of the Rspack bundle, profileinstaller 1.4.1, <profileable android:shell="true"/>, local non-distribution key
android.uiToolkit: Android Views via React Native Fabric
android.streamClient: in-app replay of the bundled stream (default); React Native WebSocket with mb.source=websocket

ios.release: Release configuration, Hermes V1 bytecode, simulator arm64, unsigned (CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO)
ios.streamClient: in-app replay of the bundled stream (default); React Native WebSocket with mb.source=websocket

R2.mechanism: Module Federation 2 remote `MbInsights` (manifest + container + chunks) loaded by Re.Pack ScriptManager: the indirection /v1/modules/repack/<platform>/current/manifest.json ({"version":"<v>"}) names the active version, then /v1/modules/repack/<platform>/<v>/mf-manifest.json is registered

R7.reason: single JS runtime: no second UI runtime to communicate with

R9.mechanism: new remote version (make remote-repack-<platform> MB_REPACK_VERSION=<v>) activated by the server indirection; every artifact URL contains the version, so ScriptManager fetches the new container instead of serving the cached old one; whole remote container, no diff

remoteIntegrity: Re.Pack CodeSigningPlugin signs the remote chunks at build time (key pair from candidates/_rn-shared/tools/ensure-signing-keys.mjs, never committed); the chunks are compiled to Hermes bytecode inside the compilation before signing (rspack.hermes.mjs: Re.Pack 5.4.2's HermesBytecodePlugin compiles after emit and would drop the signature), and scripts/verify-remote.mjs fails the remote build unless every served chunk is bytecode with a signature that verifies against the host key; the host resolver returns verifyScriptSignature "strict" with the build-time public key compiled into the installed bundle (no publicKeyPath, no in-place plist/strings edits); a rejected signature is reported as remote.error code=remote-checksum
deviations: Candidate id and directory are `repack` (application id org.example.mobilebench.repack) as assigned to this branch; design.md §13.3/§14.3 names it `rn-repack` (org.example.mobilebench.rnrepack). The integration step decides the final id.

Update stream: default source is the in-app replay of the bundled first 10000 messages (generated from fixtures/generator and verified against golden.json at build time) on the server's absolute schedule; the WebSocket source of design §7.5 is implemented and selected with mb.source=websocket (PoC launch key), pending the local server.
Instrumentation: the RN BenchKit wrapper implements the marker core in Kotlin / Objective-C++ until the shared C-ABI core exists; Android sections use android.os.Trace instead of NDK ATrace.

Marker mirror (PoC): logcat / os_log lines carry two extra tokens `t=<monotonic ns> w=<wall us>`; the control set also mirrors proc.anchor, ctr (and mem on iOS); `state` payload is `k=<k>;s=<seq>;d=<16 hex>` (k added); diagnostic markers `list.layout` and `bridge`; unknown launch keys are reported as `err code=launch-config-unknown-key;n=<count>`.

Accessibility IDs: `mb.nav.back` is not exposed (native-stack header back control; Android uses system back). PoC additions on the Selection screen: `mb.selection.<i>` per entry and `mb.selection.total`.
Restoration record v2 is stored with AsyncStorage (atomic writes by the library) instead of a temp file + rename.

`remote.request` is emitted when the Insights screen mounts, not at the tap; the remote base URL comes from mb.server at launch (registerRemotes), not from the build. The indirection document format {"version":"<v>"} is this PoC's choice: design §15.2 specifies current/manifest.json only as "manifest JSON".
mb.clearModuleCache=1 calls ScriptManager.invalidateScripts(); clearing URLCache.shared on iOS (design §8.10) is not implemented yet.

Remote chunks are compiled to Hermes bytecode by the project plugin rspack.hermes.mjs (same hermesc and flags as Re.Pack: -w -O -output-source-map) instead of Re.Pack's HermesBytecodePlugin: in Re.Pack 5.4.2 that plugin runs after CodeSigningPlugin, so the shipped bytecode carried no signature and strict verification rejected every chunk. Remote chunks ship without source maps.
iOS device family is iPhone only, equal for both RN candidates.
confounds: navigation-library: React Navigation native-stack here vs expo-router Stack in `expo` (both on react-native-screens 4.30.0)
bundler: Rspack (Re.Pack) here vs Metro in `expo`; the host bundle also contains the Module Federation runtime
